theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: SK Hynix Raises $26.5 Billion in Top US Debut by a Foreign Firm
top_news.summary: SK Hynix Inc. raised $26.5 billion in its American depositary share offering, as the South Korean memory chipmaker powered through volatility to deliver the largest ever US first-time share sale by a foreign company.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks Set to Gain After US Chipmakers Rally: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks looked poised to gain on Friday after a resurgence in giant chipmakers drove a rebound on Wall Street. Oil opened lower in early Friday trading.

top_news.title: Tanger CEO: ‘Incredible Traffic’ Tied to World Cup
top_news.summary: Stephen Yalof, President and CEO of Tanger Inc., appeared on the program to discuss the company's recent performance. Tanger is experiencing near-record results driven by strong summer traffic, contributing to a significant year-to-date stock increase of 18.28%. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Katie Greifeld on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Willow Wealth CEO on Responsibly Growing Private Markets
top_news.summary: Mitchell Caplan, CEO of Willow Wealth, discusses the evolving landscape of private market investing for individual investors. Caplan highlighted the trend of companies staying private longer, which has shifted significant wealth creation to the private phase before IPOs, citing examples like SpaceX and other mature private companies. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Katie Greifeld on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Activist Donerail Urges Beazer Homes to Engage With Suitors
top_news.summary: Activist investor Donerail Group is urging the board of Beazer Homes USA Inc. to engage with potential buyers after rival homebuilder Dream Finders Homes Inc. boosted its takeover offer this week.

top_news.title: Most Emerging Market Currencies Rebound Amid ‘Headline Fatigue’
top_news.summary: Most emerging-market currencies edged higher on Thursday, led by the Colombian peso, with oil slumping as investors played down the scope of resumed hostilities between the US and Iran.

top_news.title: Chipmakers Boost Stocks as Oil Declines | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Katie Greifeld, Carol Massar and Lisa Mateo. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Magnificent Seven’s Weakness Is Starting to Become a Problem for Wall Street
top_news.summary: One notable group has been absent from the 2026 stock rally: the American tech giants that have charged a nearly four-year bull run.

top_news.title: It’s Not Just Open Source Models Competing on Price

top_news.title: Stocks Get Boost From Chipmakers as Oil Declines: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: A resurgence in giant chipmakers powered a rebound on Wall Street, with stocks also rising amid a decline in oil prices as traders looked past fresh hostilities between the US and Iran.
